PRAYER:- Writ Petition - filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio  India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents herei  give adequate facilities, safety and protection of the tourists pub  visiting the old Courtallam Falls, Ayeraperi Village Panchayat, Ten  Taluk, Tirunelveli District, and consequently forbearing the respon  herein from allowing any illegal activities against the public safe  and comfort public in the old Courtallam Falls immediately in publi  interest.

sentences.text: Thereafter, a series of orders have been passed over the last 11 years, and we had requested, under our orders dated 08.10.2025 and 17.11.2025, for learned counsel to tabulate the directions issued and the response of the Department in regard to the stage / level of compliance with those directions.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 11/12/2025 09:14:37 pm )

4. We also requested the learned Advocate Commissioner to set out their comments in regard to whether those directions had been complied and to what extent, and whether the response of the authorities was correct.
5. A detailed tabulation has been placed before us by Ms.T.V.Lokanayaki, who appears on behalf of the learned Advocate Commissioner.
Her report is placed on file and shall be read as part and parcel of this order.
6. Our attention is specifically drawn to three areas of concern.

The first relates to direction No.17 relating to the quality checks in respect of the food served in the eateries / hotels at Courtallam,
direction No.24 relating to proper collection of parking fees and direction No.25 relating to use of plastics which have been prohibited in Courtallam and where periodic checks must be carried out by the municipal authorities.
7.The relevant direction, the department to which this direction pertains, the update of the authorities and the comments of the learned Advocate Commissioner are extracted below:-

8. Needless to say, it is the responsibility of the authorities to ensure scrupulous adherence to all other aspects of the matter that have been flagged by the parties in the annexed report.
9. The curtain falls finally on this litigation, after the period of 11 years.

10. We call for a report from the District Collector, Tenkasi District / R1, with inputs received from all the authorities on a quarterly basis for the next two years, to be filed before the Registrar (Judicial) of this Court, to be placed before the concerned Bench.
11. With this, this writ petition is closed.
No costs.
Connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
